items.text: On Linux, a pop-up a viewer page keeps in Ghoztty opens as its own window, still tied to the page that opened it.
On Linux, Ctrl+C at a picture in a viewer pane copies the picture and its file.
On Linux, a restored window reopens at its size and a renamed tab keeps its name.
On Linux, Back and Forward in a diff pane step into and out of diffs by name.
A --command window no longer closes when its command ends after a low-power switch or a config reload.
The nightly publish counts only failed tries toward its daily retry cap.
Profile-relative PATH entries resolve even when Ghoztty was started without USERPROFILE.
A glass viewer pane copies its see-through background from the window's desk instead of recomputing the gradient per pixel.
The layout-save cost test is green run alone again; its failures were already fixed by T1516.
